name: vibefoundry
description: Sets up and opens the VibeFoundry data-science IDE as a pane, and answers questions about your organization's data by querying it where it lives — installs everything it needs itself, then launches it in a terminal exactly as you would yourself.

interface.shortDescription: Open the VibeFoundry IDE, and query your data from the chat
interface.longDescription: Say "set me up to vibe code" and the plugin installs everything itself — Python, git, the data libraries, and the VibeFoundry IDE (the `vibefoundry` python package). Then "open VibeFoundry" launches it in a terminal on your current project and renders the IDE as a pane. Connect your organization once and you can ask questions about its data in the chat — the plugin finds the table, reads its columns, and runs one narrow SQL query where the data lives. No keys, no downloads.
defaultPrompt: Set me up to vibe code.
What data do I have access to?
